limitations: Feature-local verification only; centralized regression/security, eight real-client business scenarios, ten benchmarks and release remain scheduled. No release/E4 acceptance is claimed.

main denotes the existing unbranched baseline (null branch ID); it is distinct from the physical Git branch. Git bindings record observed refs/commit SHAs at creation, not a frozen Source/worktree or continuous verification of a moving Git ref.

Sources, projections and project revision remain shared. Branch metadata scopes runtime records; separate claims do not authorize concurrent writes to the shared source task. Switching does not migrate or end existing sessions/claims/evidence.

Current-branch L1 identity and process-event scoping work; named branch context with fork-based delta belongs to P7-002. Existing related-evidence summaries may include explicitly historical comparisons to other branches. Git/Source merge, reindex summary and branch close belong to P7-003.
Caller actor/model strings are provenance metadata, not authentication or proof of independent review. Legacy branch rows without creation receipts retain unverified Git references.
